claims.text: Elboron was the son of Faramir and Éowyn. Upon his father's death in , he became the second Prince of Ithilien and the Steward of Gondor.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Peoples of Middle-earth, "VII. The Heirs of Elendil", p. 221; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "The Realms in Exile", "The Southern Line: Heirs of Anarion", Ruling Stewards, entry for Denethor II, p. 1039; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Steward and the King", p. 967

claims.text: Elboron was either the father or uncle of Barahir, the grandson of Faramir who wrote The Tale of Aragorn and Arwen.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, "Prologue", "Note on the Shire Records", p. 15
